providers.title: Erdős's parabola
providers.scope: The p points (x/p, (x^2 mod p)/p) have no triangle of area below 1/(2p^2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Power improvement (OpenAI)
providers.scope: There are eta, c_1 > 0 such that Delta(n) >= c_1 n^(-2+eta) for every large n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Area of projected points
providers.scope: The projections of three columns with positive third coordinates span a triangle of area |det A|/(2 u_3 v_3 w_3).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Prime intervals
providers.scope: For every large n there is a prime in (n, 2n].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Index and covolume
providers.scope: Z^n/MZ^n has |det M| elements; a full-rank sublattice of Z^n has index equal to its covolume.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Successive lengths
providers.scope: det L <= lambda_1 ... lambda_s <= s^(s/2) det L.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Integral planes
providers.scope: Lambda cap y^perp has determinant I|y|/g, where g generates y . Lambda.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fixed nonzero determinant (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Matrices with rows in a lattice of index I, of length at most X >= lambda_3, and determinant t != 0 number at most C (log 2X)^2 X^6/I^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A sum of determinants
providers.scope: The norm of the 3 x 3 determinant over a field with r^d elements is a sum of T determinants of monomials of degree d.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Determinant obstruction (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Three digit columns with distinct labels have a determinant modulo h with no integer representative in [-tau, tau].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Diagonal form
providers.scope: A residue matrix with a unit entry is P diag(1, B^b, B^e) Q; its row lattice has index B^(b+e) and contains B^e Z^3.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Orbit bound
providers.scope: The orbit of C under SL_3 modulo h has at least (21/64) h^8/(D^3 E^2) elements.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The smaller divisor of digit matrices
providers.scope: E[D | labels] <= 2 for every triple of labels, and E[D 1_F] <= 6 r^(-d) for the event F that two labels coincide.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A cap in a box
providers.scope: The box {0, ..., w-1}^3 contains at least w^3/q points of F_q^3 with no three on a line.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The random set (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Three distinct points of V satisfy no integer relation with a coefficient vector of length at most H.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Inclusion weights
providers.scope: W(A) <= C for affinely independent residues, C q^3/s for rank at least two, and C (q^3/s)^2 always.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lifting identity
providers.scope: Given labels and digits, the probability of a set of matrices is h^9/(N^9 |O|) times their total weight.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Probability of a bad triple (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Three samples form a bad triple with probability at most C (log 2N)^2 h/(N^3 r^d).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Weighted zero-determinant count (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Singular matrices with columns in the box, rows in Lambda and distinct projections have total weight at most C log(2N) N^6/I^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Deletion
providers.scope: Some outcome keeps n_r points whose triangles all have area at least tau/(16N^3).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Size of n_r
providers.scope: A_k r^alpha <= n_r <= D_k r^alpha with alpha = 45435k + 16, which gives eta = 2/alpha.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
